title: Ledger 3 — Memory write (can this memory be trusted?)
description: arch §5 L3: per write — source type, timestamp, authoring agent, supporting evidence, transformation operation, confidence, update history. Trust labels surviving LLM-mediated derivation (MemLineage pattern). The full lineage set is load-bearing (must-map): FK2 rejects any memory/corpus write missing a field; FK3's deletion DAG walks these edges.

target_id.description: Id of the memory/corpus object written (entry id or entry_id#block_id — block-level atomicity, arch §3.3.2)

source_type.description: Load-bearing lineage field: where the content came from (e.g. principal-direct, harness-artifact, connector:<name>, agent-derivation, external-untrusted) — drives taint tier (arch §7.7) and export separation (arch §10.3)

authoring_agent.description: Load-bearing lineage field: which agent/component authored the write

evidence.description: Load-bearing lineage field: supporting evidence, cited at block level (arch §3.3.2)

transformation.description: Load-bearing lineage field: the operation that produced this content from its sources (e.g. adapter-translation, compilation-distill, verbatim-copy)

confidence.description: Load-bearing lineage field: writer's confidence in the content (graded label or 'unrated')

basis.description: Derivation basis (Graphify-borrow): weakest edge among the write's sources — extracted (read directly) / inferred (agent-resolved) / ambiguous (untrusted or uncertain → routes to human review). Optional; missing reads as ambiguous.

update_history_ref.description: Load-bearing lineage field: reference to prior versions of the target (fork: git history, L6)

trust_label.description: Cryptographic trust label surviving derivation and cross-session persistence (MemLineage)

parent_ids.description: Ids of memory/corpus objects this write derives from — the lineage-DAG edges L9 deletion propagation walks (arch §5.3)
